svg.title: EquityLens, our COS 301 capstone with Amazon Web Services as industry client: portfolio analytics for South African retail investors. Screenshot of the dashboard's performance against the benchmark, where each dot is a day a holding moved unusually far.

g.text: See why your portfolio moved, not just that it did.
Each dot is a day one holding moved unusually far for itself. Click it for the event study and the news around it.
